goal.en: Talk about where you live, what you eat, and how you get around your town.
goal.ar: أن تتحدث عن مسكنك وطعامك وكيف تتنقل في مدينتك.

a1read.title: A note on the kitchen table
a1read.text:
Mum,
I am at the market. I need tomatoes, bread and some rice for tonight. The pharmacy next to the bank is closed today, so I will get your medicine tomorrow.
There is tea in the kitchen and there are eggs in the fridge. Please do not use the last two eggs — they are for breakfast.
I am going on foot, so I will be home at six.
Nadia

text.en: Rooms take “in”: in the kitchen. Floors take “on”: on the third floor.
text.ar: الغرف تأخذ in فنقول in the kitchen، والطوابق تأخذ on فنقول on the third floor.

text.en: “House” is a building you live in alone; “flat” (UK) or “apartment” (US) is one home inside a bigger building. Most city dwellers live in a flat, not a house.
text.ar: house بيت مستقل، أما الشقة داخل عمارة فهي flat في البريطانية وapartment في الأمريكية. فمعظم سكان المدن يعيشون في flat لا house.

items.en: We live in a flat on the fourth floor.
items.ar: نعيش في شقة في الطابق الرابع.

items.en: The kitchen is small but bright.

text.en: Meals take no “the”: I have breakfast at seven. Never “the breakfast”.
text.ar: أسماء الوجبات لا تأخذ the فنقول I have breakfast at seven ولا نقول the breakfast.

text.en: «خبز» and «أرز» are ordinary nouns in Arabic, so “I ate two breads” feels natural — but bread and rice are uncountable. Say “two loaves of bread”, “some rice”.
text.ar: «الخبز» و«الأرز» أسماء عادية في العربية، لذا تبدو two breads طبيعية، لكنها في الإنجليزية غير معدودة. قل two loaves of bread أو some rice.

items.en: I usually have eggs and bread for breakfast.
items.ar: أتناول عادةً البيض والخبز في الفطور.

text.en: Transport takes “by” with no “the”: by bus, by car, by train. The exception is walking: on foot.
text.ar: وسائل النقل تأخذ by بلا the: by bus وby car. والاستثناء المشي فيقال on foot.

text.en: “I go to the work by the bus” has two extra “the”s. Say “I go to work by bus”. Work, school and home drop the article.
text.ar: جملة I go to the work by the bus فيها the زائدة مرتين. الصواب I go to work by bus، فكلمات work وschool وhome تُحذف معها أداة التعريف.

items.en: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
I go to school on foot.

questions.sentence: Our flat is ___ the third floor.

explanation.en: Floors take “on”, even though rooms take “in”.
explanation.ar: الطوابق تأخذ on مع أن الغرف تأخذ in.

prompt.en: You live on the fifth floor of a big building. What is your home?
prompt.ar: تسكن في الطابق الخامس من عمارة كبيرة. ماذا يسمى مسكنك؟

explanation.en: One home inside a larger building is a flat (UK) or apartment (US).
explanation.ar: المسكن داخل عمارة أكبر يسمى flat بالبريطانية أو apartment بالأمريكية.

questions.answer: There are two bedrooms in our flat

explanation.en: “There are” for plural, then the place at the end.
explanation.ar: نبدأ بـ There are للجمع ثم المكان في النهاية.

questions.sentence: I have ___ at seven o'clock every morning.

explanation.en: Meal names take no article: have breakfast.
explanation.ar: أسماء الوجبات بلا أداة تعريف: have breakfast.

options: I bought two loaves of bread.

explanation.en: Bread is uncountable, so it has no plural. Count the loaves instead.
explanation.ar: كلمة bread غير معدودة فلا تُجمع، بل نعدّ الأرغفة loaves.

explanation.en: Rice is uncountable, so it takes “much”.

prompt.en: Match the food to its group.

explanation.en: Grouping words together makes them much easier to remember than a long list.
explanation.ar: تجميع الكلمات في فئات يسهّل حفظها أكثر من القائمة الطويلة.

prompt.en: Complete politely: “___ you like some tea?” (one word)
prompt.ar: أكمل بأدب: «___ you like some tea؟» (كلمة واحدة)

explanation.en: “Would you like…?” is the polite offer. “Do you want…?” is direct and can sound blunt.
explanation.ar: Would you like هي صيغة العرض المهذبة، أما Do you want فمباشرة وقد تبدو جافة.

questions.sentence: I need medicine, so I'm going to the ___.

explanation.en: Medicine comes from a pharmacy (also called a chemist in Britain).
explanation.ar: الدواء يُشترى من pharmacy، وتسمى chemist في بريطانيا.

explanation.en: Transport takes “by” with no article: by bus.
explanation.ar: وسائل النقل تأخذ by بلا أداة تعريف: by bus.

options: I go to the work every day.
I go to work every day.
I go to the office every day.

explanation.en: “Work” drops the article; “the office” keeps it because it is a specific place.
explanation.ar: كلمة work تُحذف معها أداة التعريف، أما the office فتبقى لأنها مكان محدد.

questions.sentence: The market is ___ to the bank.

explanation.en: The fixed phrase is “next to”. “Close” needs “to” as well: close to the bank.
explanation.ar: التعبير الثابت هو next to، وclose تحتاج to أيضاً: close to the bank.

questions.answer: I usually go to the market on Friday

explanation.en: Frequency word before the verb, place before time.
explanation.ar: ظرف التكرار قبل الفعل، والمكان قبل الزمان.

prompt.en: Someone says “It's five minutes on foot.” How are they travelling?
prompt.ar: قال أحدهم It's five minutes on foot. كيف سينتقل؟

explanation.en: “On foot” is the fixed phrase for walking — the one form of transport that does not take “by”.
explanation.ar: on foot تعبير ثابت يعني المشي، وهو الوسيلة الوحيدة التي لا تأخذ by.

explanation.en: The first line says “I am at the market.”
explanation.ar: يقول السطر الأول I am at the market.

prompt.en: Why will she get the medicine tomorrow?

explanation.en: “The pharmacy… is closed today, so I will get your medicine tomorrow.”
explanation.ar: النص يقول إن الصيدلية مغلقة اليوم، لذلك ستحضر الدواء غداً.

prompt.ar: ما الذي يجب ألا يستعمله أحد؟

explanation.en: “Please do not use the last two eggs — they are for breakfast.”
explanation.ar: يقول النص: لا تستعملوا آخر بيضتين فهما للفطور.

explanation.en: “On foot” is the fixed phrase for walking.
explanation.ar: on foot تعبير ثابت يعني المشي.
